Expanded-section link → "API Versioning Strategy"; related-documents item error-handling → "Error Handling Standards".

evidence: Clicking node monitoring-alerts set data-semtag-state="selected" (plus pulsing halo circle + thicker stroke) and cleared the previous selection. Zoom In 100%→120%, Zoom Out →100%→80% with graph.zoom readout and SVG transform scale updating in step; wheel zoom also works. Reset View verified separately.

Graph contains all 19 documents from all 5 modules as nodes and 19 edges matching every related-document pair. nav.documents / nav.graph / nav.favorites all present; clicking each sets state="active" and renders the corresponding view (document list+detail, graph SVG with zoom controls, favorites list with empty-state message).

issue: Favorites view is filtered by the Documents module filter and hides favorited documents from other modules
actual: Favorited jwt-authentication, rest-api-design, design-tokens (nav badge updated 0→1→3 immediately; markers survived module filter AUTH and sort-by-date; persisted after page reload with badge still 3).
